instruction: Open the power settings and enable the battery percentage display in the top bar.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
import pyautogui; pyautogui.press('escape'); import time; time.sleep(0.3);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling battery percentage display in the top bar via power/interface settings. Initial config sets show-battery-percentage to false. Agent must navigate settings and enable it. Evaluator verifies show-battery-percentage is true.

Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling battery percentage display, evaluator verifies show-battery-percentage setting is true
